Special Branch Station,
Date March 3, 1941

REPORT

Subject J. K. HORA, Czechoslovakian

Made by D.S.L. Pitts Forwarded by C.D.L. Tabrum

With reference to the contents of the
attached report dated December 9, 1940 information
has been secured recently from sources that are
usually reliable to the effect that J. K. HORA,
Czechoslovakian, was sent to Shanghai by the
Nazi-controlled Gestapo for the express purpose
of causing dissension and disorganization in the
ranks of the followers of the Free Czech Movement
in China. His efforts here towards this end
have met with failure thanks to the obstacles
placed in his path by members of the local Czech
Circle.

He has had close connections with Messrs.
Melchers & Co. (German concern) since his arrival
in Shanghai last summer and it is believed that he
has been receiving funds from the Germans through
this organization. He has been observed on several
occasions in German circles in Shanghai and it is
definitely known that he is pro-Nazi in his outlook
on life. In this connection it is not out of
place to mention that he was attached to the
Austrian Intelligence Service during the last war.

He tried hard in Shanghai to become a
member of the Czech Circle but he was given to
understand by leading officials of this organization
that any application received from him would be
blackballed. He took the advice and did not
submit an application for membership.

Having regard to his connections in

报告

事由：捷克人 J. K. HORA

具报人：D.S.L. Pitts 转呈人：C.D.L. Tabrum

鉴于所附1940年12月9日报告之内容，近期从通常可靠的消息来源获悉，捷克人 J. K. HORA 系由纳粹控制的盖世太保派往上海，其明确目的旨在引起在华自由捷克运动追随者队伍内部的纷争与混乱。由于当地捷克圈子成员从中作梗，他在此方面所作的努力未能得逞。

自去年夏季抵达上海以来，他与美最时洋行（德国商行）关系密切，据信他正通过该组织从德国人那里接受资金。有人多次在上海的德国人圈子中观察到他的身影，且确知他在人生观上持亲纳粹立场。在此方面，值得一提的是，他在上次大战期间曾隶属于奥地利情报部门。

他曾极力试图成为捷克圈子的一员，但该组织的主要负责人向他表明，任何来自他的入会申请都将遭到否决（blackballed）。他听从了建议，未提交入会申请。

南非的关系（见前一份报告），得知此人于昨日早晨（1941年3月8日）离开上海，乘坐荷兰轮船“特格尔贝格”号（ss. Tegelberg）前往开普敦，也就不足为奇了。他已获得英王陛下总领事馆签发的签证，允许他在前往南非联邦途中经过英国属地，以及允许他进入南非的签证。此外，他还获得了美国总领事馆签发的过境签证，允许他途经菲律宾。

目前掌握的所有信息均表明，HORA 是一个极其危险的人物，他与纳粹分子勾结，为一个此处无需赘述的目的而工作。他在上海的任务已告失败，看来他正被派往南非去那里制造麻烦；鉴于他与许多南非高层要员关系融洽（persona grata），且深谙捣乱之道，其意图何在似乎显而易见。

REPORT
Date: December 9, 1940

Subject......... Lecture given at the Czechoslovak Circle on December 8, 1940
by Mr. J. K. HORA, Czechoslovakian.
Made by......... D.S.I. Pitts .................... Forwarded by ....... D. I. Crawford

Between the hours of 8.45 p.m. and 11.45 p.m.
December 8, 1940 at the Czechoslovak Circle, 214
Avenue du Roi Albert, Mr. J. K. HORA, a Czechoslovakian,
gave a lecture to some 30 persons of the same race,
the subject being "South Africa." The subject was
treated from a topical point of view and no political
angles at all were introduced. The last seventy
minutes of the lecture were taken up with the screening
of an English language talkie film on South Africa
which was lent to the lecturer by Mr. P. D. G. Gain,
local South African Trade Commissioner.

Mr. HORA was, it is said, formerly Honorary
Czech Consul in Johannesburg and he has produced in
Shanghai certain documents from General Smuts and
other high South African dignitaries showing that he
was well thought of in the Union.

Little is known of his recent activities save
that he returned to Shanghai from Czechoslovakia
in the summer of 1940. In 1915 and 1916, however, he
was the Shanghai representative of the Skoda Munitions
works and at that time he was known for his pro-
German and Austrian sympathies. The local Czechs
are, at present, not certain of his sympathies and
this is the reason they gave him the opportunity of
giving the lecture on December 8, 1940. He is not
a member of the Czechoslovak Club but nothing is
known that would adversely reflect to his character.

During the lecture in question, which was given
in the Czech language, nothing of an untoward nature

报告
日期：1940年12月9日

事由......... 1940年12月8日捷克人 J. K. HORA 先生在捷克圈子发表的演讲。
具报人......... D.S.I. Pitts .................... 转呈人 ....... D. I. Crawford

1940年12月8日晚8时45分至11时45分之间，在阿尔伯特王路214号捷克圈子，捷克人 J. K. HORA 先生向约30名同族人士发表演讲，主题为“南非”。演讲从时事角度切入，未涉及任何政治角度。演讲的最后七十分钟用于放映一部关于南非的英语有声电影，该片由当地南非贸易专员 P. D. G. Gain 先生借给演讲者。

据说 HORA 先生曾任驻约翰内斯堡的捷克荣誉领事，他在上海出示了来自史末资将军及其他南非高官的文件，表明他在南非联邦颇受器重。

除知道他于1940年夏季从捷克斯洛伐克返回上海外，对其近期活动知之甚少。然而，在1915年和1916年，他是斯柯达兵工厂（Skoda Munitions works）的上海代表，当时他以亲德和亲奥地利的倾向而闻名。当地捷克人目前不确定他的倾向，这就是他们给予他在1940年12月8日发表演讲机会的原因。他不是捷克俱乐部的成员，但也未发现任何有损其品格的情况。

在这次用捷克语进行的演讲过程中，没有发生任何不愉快之事
